messages:
marie: Quick brain-dump: prototype for 'progressive-tile' loader. Store each shard as fixed-size tiles (default 1MB) + TileMap sidecar mapping tensor->tile-range. Warmup pulls tiles by heatmap instead of contiguous byte ranges. Goal: bounded small reads, predictable memory growth, better compression alignment.

devin: tile size 1MB ok. How do tiles handle tensor boundaries? safetensors expects contiguous arrays.

marie: TileMap has entries (tensor_name, tile_start, tile_end, offset_in_first_tile, sha256). If tensor spans tiles we stitch during commit. Readers only see tiles after verification and atomic merge. No partial-tile reads.

alejandro: how do we pick tiles to prefetch?

marie: two signals: static profile from evals (common prompt access order) + online short-term KV histogram (last N requests, decayed). Merge into a top-K tile prefetch list per shard. Start with seed tiles 0..N then heatmap-driven phase.

kevin: multi-turns may jump layers. Fallbacks?

marie: if thrash detected (many splits/evictions) runtime escalates to shard-hotstart for that model version. Also adaptive backoff: if >M splits in Tms escalate.

alejandro: compressed blobs? tiles align with compression frames?

marie: prefer block-compressed container (zstd frames per tile). For legacy gzip/chunked we fall back to chunk-granularity addressing and mark addressing_mode in TileMap ({raw,frame,chunked}). Tile size becomes multiple-of-chunk for gzip.

kevin: atomicity & determinism concerns?

marie: every tile verified via SHA before commit. Commit uses epoched cache map so readers never see partial tiles. Also include model-versioned tile manifest to preserve determinism across nodes.

devin: network/concurrency: many small tile fetches could overload storage.

marie: aggregator coalesces identical tile requests in a 10ms window, per-shard concurrency cap, token-bucket rate limit per model, and telemetry-triggered fallback-to-seed-only. Metrics: tile.prefetch.fallback_rate, tile.verify_failures, tile.prefetch_bytes.

alejandro: migration path?

marie: TileMap is optional sidecar: file.safetensors.tilemap.json. Registry will generate on upload. We ship a tileizer CLI to emit sidecars for existing bundles. Bundles without TileMap use index-first or full-hotstart.

ci-bot: ci-note: add unit tests for tile-stitching, compressed-frame addressing, tilemap-backcompat. Ticket ML-2042.

marie: rollout: feature-flag per-model loader: "progressive_tile_v1". Start canary in eng-nonprod with small & 8-shard models. QA checklist: deterministic seeding tests, tile-corruption injection, concurrency storm sim, eviction mixed-workload. Perf microbench: bytes_read vs first_token_latency for seed sizes (16KB,128KB,1MB).

kevin: logging: tile_id, shard_id, request_affinity, fetch_mode. Helps debug hotstart pathologies.

marie: open question: per-shard tile-size tuning vs global. Might add histogram-based packing in v2. I'll draft RFC follow-up with TileMap schema, tileizer CLI, metrics, and a minimal PoC. Thanks all :memo:
